Nonempty B and α≤b≤β imply α≤β, so their difference β−α+η is positive and max truncation disappears. Both supplied contracts have no hypotheses. BG001–BG009 verify the omitted basic order, metric and measurability applications with their actual conditions; no E application occurs.

The displayed route is valid with the nine verified basic-background notes. Choosing any point of nonempty B gives explicit real bounds b₀±ρ. Conditional-completeness properties then justify α≤b≤β. For each b∈B the pairwise bound makes b+ρ an upper bound, hence β≤b+ρ; thus β−ρ is a lower bound, giving β−α≤ρ. Nonemptiness also implies α≤β. η/2>0 gives strict enclosure by J and positive length β−α+η≤ρ+η. M009 computes λ(J); monotonicity, explicitly provided by D010, bounds λ(J∩I). B need not be measurable. Interval/intersection Borel claims are verified in BG001,BG008,BG009. The case ρ=0 remains valid, and no infimum or supremum needs to belong to B.
